title: The Spirit Gives Life
story:
A farmer planted a small seed in the ground and waited patiently.

For several days, nothing seemed to happen. The soil looked exactly the same, and there was no sign of life.

But beneath the surface, something was happening. The seed was beginning to grow roots.

After some time, a small green shoot appeared above the ground.

The farmer smiled because he knew that life had been working beneath the surface long before it became visible.

Sometimes our spiritual lives can feel the same way.

We may pray and wonder whether anything is changing. We may struggle with old habits, discouragement, fear, or weakness and wonder if we are really growing.

But God's work in us is not always immediately visible.

Romans 8:11 reminds us that the Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from the dead, lives in those who belong to Christ. The same Spirit who raised Christ gives life to our mortal bodies.

This is a powerful reminder that Christian life does not depend only on our own strength.

God's Spirit is at work within us.

He gives us strength when we are weak, hope when we are discouraged, wisdom when we are uncertain, and power to overcome the things that once controlled us.

There may be areas of your life where you have tried again and again to change but feel like nothing is happening.

Do not give up.

Keep surrendering those areas to God.

Spend time in prayer, read His Word, listen to His guidance, and take the next faithful step.

Growth may sometimes be slow and difficult to see, but God's Spirit is not inactive.

The same God who raised Jesus from the dead is able to bring new life into places that seem weak, broken, or hopeless.

He can renew your heart, strengthen your faith, restore your joy, and help you live differently.

Today, do not focus only on your weaknesses.

Remember the power of the Holy Spirit living within you.

Your strength may be limited, but God's power is not.

Trust Him to bring life, renewal, and transformation into every area you place in His hands.
life_lesson: The Christian life is not lived by human strength alone. The same Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in God's people and gives strength, renewal, and life. Trust His power to transform you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving me Your Holy Spirit and for the life and power that come from You.

Thank You that I do not have to depend only on my own strength.

When I feel weak, discouraged, or unable to change, remind me that Your Spirit is working within me.

Bring new life to every area of my heart that feels tired, broken, or hopeless.

Help me overcome old habits, sinful desires, fear, and anything that keeps me from living according to Your will.

Give me strength when I am weak, wisdom when I am uncertain, and courage when I am afraid.

Teach me to surrender myself to the leading of Your Spirit every day.

Help me spend time in prayer and Your Word so that my relationship with You becomes stronger.

When I cannot see progress, help me trust that You are still working beneath the surface.

Renew my mind, restore my joy, strengthen my faith, and make my life fruitful for Your glory.

Thank You that the same Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead is able to give life and strength to me.

Help me trust Your power and walk with You every day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there an area of your life where you feel too weak or discouraged to change?

Are you depending mainly on your own strength instead of surrendering to the Holy Spirit?

What is one area of your life where you need to ask God for new life and renewal today?
verse: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit who lives in you.
